GP chronic disease management planactiveplan14-Jan 25 - 14-Jan 26Recently retired (45 years in construction and heavy industry). Main problems are bilateral knee osteoarthritis and chronic mechanical low back pain, limiting walking and lifting, and noise-induced hearing loss, now aided. Cardiovascular risk: treated hypertension and hyperlipidaemia, ex-smoker, BMI 30; LDL above target. Plan: exercise physiology and physiotherapy under a GP management plan; weight loss to 90 kg; keep NSAID use intermittent (blood pressure, renal function); increase atorvastatin to 40 mg if LDL still above 2.0 in 3 months; annual audiology review; review in 3 months with blood pressure, lipids and renal function. He wants to stay active for his grandchildren and his garden.
